title: Spouses of HDB Flat or Executive Condominium Owners who Have Bought Private Properties
what_it_is: Spouses of HDB Flat or Executive Condominium Owners who Have Bought Private Properties

sections.label: HDB data limitations on occupants
sections.summary: HDB lacks data on occupants of spouses' EC units and on whether occupiers bought private property in their own or joint names.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As such, HDB does not have data of all who are currently occupants of the EC unit that their spouse is an owner of.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As for those registered as occupiers of their spouse's HDB flat, HDB's data only captures whether they proceeded to purchase a private property after fulfilling the requisite Minimum Occupation Period.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, HDB does not capture whether they purchased the private property in their own name or jointly with others.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As such, HDB is unable to provide the specific information that the Member had asked for.
